title: Saudi Arabian Lentil Kebabs
description: A flavorful and healthy dish from the heart of the Arabian Peninsula. Marinated lentils are grilled to perfection and served with a side of aromatic spices.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine lentils, aromatic spice blend, saudi Arabian spices, olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, salt, and black pepper. Mix well to combine.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes or up to 2 hours.
Thread the marinated lentils onto skewers, leaving a small space between each lentil.
Brush the grill grates with olive oil to prevent sticking.
Grill the lentil kebabs for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, or until cooked through and slightly charred.
Serve hot with your favorite sides, such as rice, salad, or flatbread.
